arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Maryland argues arrestees are in a unique category. They are on the gateway into the criminal justice system. Their privacy expectations are substantially reduced.
King argues the search was warrantless and suspicionless. He claims this practice is presumptively unconstitutional. He argues the state cites no valid exception.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Maryland wants to keep its law requiring DNA collection from arrestees. It claims this practice helps solve crimes. King wants the court to strike down the law. He argues it violates his Fourth Amendment rights.
